scope: Small manually verified catalogue refresh from primary publisher, studio and artist sources; not a comprehensive live release feed. Descriptions are project paraphrases, not lyric claims.

items.title: Project Hail Mary (film)
items.description: Science teacher Ryland Grace is far from Earth. He forms a connection with an unexpected ally, and their cooperation overcomes barriers between them in space.

items.title: The Mandalorian and Grogu
items.description: After the Empire's defeat, the New Republic recruits a bounty hunter and his young apprentice to confront remaining forces across the galaxy.

items.title: The Odyssey
items.description: Homer's ancient saga becomes a mythic action adventure involving heroes, gods and monsters.

items.title: Platform Decay
items.description: Murderbot volunteers for a rescue mission and must work with unfamiliar humans, including children. This is a science-fiction sequel in the Murderbot Diaries, combining cooperation with the protagonist's discomfort around people.

items.title: The Strength of the Few
items.description: In this epic-fantasy sequel to The Will of the Many, Vis exists across three worlds. He must manage dangerous secrets and search for answers while trying to prevent a catastrophe.

items.title: First Light
items.description: Lana Del Rey's theme song for the James Bond video game 007 First Light. The artist's official video establishes the credited work and release; the catalogue does not contain its lyrics or acoustic measurements.
items.evidence_kind: official release credits, not lyric interpretation

items.title: Aperture
items.description: Harry Styles released Aperture as the lead single for Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally. This record supplies release and artist information; it has no lyric interpretation or measured acoustic features.
